source_instruction: i'm looking for 1 resealed bag of puffed snacks
query: Ugh, I swear my cat knocked over my houseplant this morning and got soil all over the entryway rug, I spent 20 minutes scrubbing it before I left and I still think there’s a smudge by the shoe rack. Also the barista at the café downstairs messed up my oat milk latte and made it way too sweet, I could barely drink half of it on the walk over. Oh, and I remembered I need to pick up dry cleaning after this, they said my wool sweater would be ready by 3pm today. Anyway, I’m in the breakfast foods section right now, I need the ones that come in a resealable bag, just get 1 of them, and don’t go over that one, yeah?
